title: Astraeus field catalogue
description: The canonical list of fields the evidence layer exposes, independent of which source produced them. One physical quantity per key; related quantities grouped into families that carry the comparability note.

catalogue_version.description: Versioned so a manifest can say which catalogue it was written against.

key.description: Project style: snake case, level suffix for height fields (temperature_2m, wind_u_10m).

note.description: The comparability note. What the family measures and where its members stop being comparable.

groups.description: Comparability group label -> why the members of that group mean the same thing. Two fields are comparable only inside one group.

units.description: The normalized unit the experiment stores, not the provider's. Null only where the producer declares the unit per artifact and no normalization pins it; a null unit switches the manifest unit check off for that key and must carry a reason in the description.

level.description: The level convention. Height fields carry the level in the key and repeat it here; a profile field says which coordinate carries its levels.

level_coordinate.description: For a profile field, the coordinate that carries the levels. One key with a coordinate, never one key per level.

level_suffix_pattern.description: Regular expression matching the level-expanded artifact variable names that resolve to this profile key, e.g. relative_humidity_850hPa. Present only on profile fields.

standard_name.description: CF standard_name where one exists. Null for class indices, health flags and geometry, which CF does not name.

comparability_group.description: Members of one family are comparable only when they share this group.

evidence_classes.description: The classes this field may carry. A value of any other class is refused rather than served.

phase_attribute.description: True where every value must carry a liquid/mixed phase attribute stamped from the producer's own specific humidity.

range.description: Physical range, inclusive, where one is meaningful.

subsetting.description: Whether the access path subsets to the evidence box before the bytes leave the producer.

policy.description: every_published_field for a server-side-subsetting source; family_fields_only for a feed with no subsetting, whose remaining records are catalogued available-not-stored.

upstream.description: The producer's own name for the quantity: a WCS coverage id, a GRIB record label, a JSON member.

storage.description: stored: retrieved and kept under the catalogue key. available-not-stored: the producer publishes it and this deployment does not fetch it; visible, never served as a bare null. not-published: the producer leaves the gap, so the field stays null and nothing derives it.

phase.description: The saturation phase this producer's humidity is defined over, measured against its own specific humidity.
